fullContentHtml:
Short Information : has released the marks for the Group A, B & C Various Posts on the official website of the DDA Delhi. This recruitment was released for 1732 posts. Applications for the DDA Group A, B, C Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 06 October 2025, to 05 November 2025. The Skill Test examination was held on 02-03 March 2026. Candidates who appeared for this Examination can download their DDA Group A, B, C Marks 2026 from the link given below.

Delhi Development Authority (DDA)

DDA Group A, B & C Various Posts Marks 2026

DDA Advt No. 09/2025

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 06 October 2025
  • Last Date : 05 November 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 November 2024
  • Exam Date : 16 December 2025 to 03 January 2025
  • Exam City Details : 08 December 2025
  • Admit Card : 14 December 2025
  • Stage-2 Skill Test Date (Stenographer, JSA, Junior Translator) : January / February 2026 (Tentative)
  • Interview Date (Wherever Applicable) : January / February 2026 (Tentative)
  • Answer Key : 05 January 2026 
  • Result Updated : 20 February 2026 
  • Skill Test Exam Date : 24-25 February 2026
  • Skill Test Stage-II : 02-03 March 2026
  • Result (Junior Engineer) : 10 March 2026 
  • Result (Mali) : 27 March 2026
  • Result (MTS) : 02 April 2026  
  • Result (JSA) : 07 April 2026
  • Final Result (Stenographer) : 07 May 2026
  • Marks : 08 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 2500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 1500/-
  • All Female Candidates : Rs. 1500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

Delhi DDA Group, A, B, C Notification 2025 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 05 November 2025
  • Minimum Age : 18 – 21 Years (Post Wise)
  • Maximum Age : 25 – 40 Years (Post Wise)
  • Age Relaxation as per Delhi DDA Group, A, B, C Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

How To Download DDA Group A, B & C Various Posts Marks 2026

  • Check the Important Links section.
  • Then click on the Download Marks link.
  • After clicking on the link, candidates will be redirected to the Dashboard page.
  • In this page candidates have to fill up the following fields with proper details:
    Candidate’s Registration Number
    Date of Birth
    Gender
    Verification Code
  • Then the candidates will be required to submit the details in order to download the marks.
  • The candidate can also download their marks download from the official Website.
